to.section: Purpose: writing-time discipline for agent prose to humans

Scope and discipline principles: protect core, keep meaning-bearers, cut filler, never grow text, one word one meaning, no invented abbreviations, no tool narration, stay on thread, errors as facts, completion stated plainly, deferral with a when, no decoration, close on action
Auto-clarity: suspend terse prose for warnings, irreversible confirmations, ambiguous sequences
Relationship to companion disciplines: minimal-code, agent-doc, prose
Verification checklist before reporting prose done
